summary: Newton Golf Company, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing warrant exchange agreements dated September 21-22, 2026 with three holders of Series A Common Warrants issued December 13, 2024. The company repurchased warrants exercisable for an aggregate 749,999 common shares, issuing 232,202 shares instead, with share count calculated using a $0.35 reference price divided by the lower of the prior Nasdaq close or the trailing five-day average close under Listing Rule 5635(d). Holders also received a 12-month pro rata Buyer Purchase Option covering 10% of future offerings, excluding exempt issuances and at-the-market sales. Watch dilution and any refiled capital raises.
